items.description: Colourful bouquets made fresh on Otley Road for birthdays, thank yous or just because.
Wedding flowers made to fit your day, from bouquets to venue arrangements.
Weekly flowers delivered to keep offices bright, arranged to suit your space.

services.heading: Bouquets, wedding flowers and weekly arrangements made with care.

about.statement: We love bringing colour and life to north Leeds, one bouquet and one office arrangement at a time.

items.question: Where is your flower shop?
items.answer: We're a flower shop on Otley Road, making bouquets, wedding flowers and weekly office arrangements.

items.question: Do you deliver the same day?
items.answer: Yes, order before noon and we'll deliver across north Leeds the same day.

items.question: Can you do flowers for weddings?
items.answer: Yes, we create wedding flowers that fit your day, from bouquets to venue arrangements.

items.question: Do you offer flowers for offices?
items.answer: Yes, we deliver fresh flowers weekly, arranged to suit your office space.

items.question: How far do you deliver?
items.answer: We deliver across north Leeds, same day if you order before noon.
